product_one_liner.value: Cast AI helps DevOps and platform teams automate Kubernetes resource management to reduce cloud costs and improve application performance.
product_one_liner.notes: The announcements identify Cast AI as a Kubernetes automation platform and explicitly describe DevOps/platform teams automating resource management, lowering costs, and improving performance. Sources: https://cast.ai/press-release/cast-ai-extends-automation-and-cost-optimization-capabilities-to-on-premises-and-additional-cloud-providers and https://cast.ai/press-release/kimchi-coding-hits-general-availability.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL presents a custom-quote request and says contact is necessary for pricing; it does not list plans or prices. It is therefore treated as a quote/contact form rather than a substantive pricing page under the requested definition: https://cast.ai/pricing.

eng_blog.notes: Under the requested strict definition, the reviewed Engineering index did not establish two engineer-authored articles about building the product. One clear architecture article was identified, by Augustinas Stirbis, explaining the IPsec/Cilium/VXLAN implementation. This negative is limited by incomplete evidence about older posts. Sources: https://cast.ai/blog/category/engineering/ and https://cast.ai/blog/the-no-nonsense-guide-for-engineers/.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal offers guides, tutorials, API reference material, and detailed feature documentation, including supported LLM providers. Sources: https://docs.cast.ai/docs and https://docs.cast.ai/docs/ai-supported-providers.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router) posting describes responsibility for routing-model features, training, calibration, and releases: https://cast.ai/careers/apply?gh_jid=4451280009.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Mistral (supported external LLM providers).
model_provider.notes: The AI Enabler documentation names OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, and Mistral as external API-provider examples. This establishes supported product integrations, rather than a claim that every provider is used for every request: https://docs.cast.ai/docs/ai-supported-providers.
